a_before_b.rationale: Identifying scalability bottlenecks in evaluation is not required to design evaluation data slices representing production distribution, user tiers, traffic sources, known failure cases, and out-of-scope inputs.

b_before_a.rationale: Designing evaluation data slices is not required to identify scalability bottlenecks in evaluation caused by high costs, time requirements, and lack of standardization in human annotation and testing of large generative outputs.
